engine_behaviour: a plan whose stop is beyond 15% of the live price is rejected (CATI_STRUCTURAL_STOP_EXCEEDS_SYSTEM_MAX); the stop is never moved or clipped

prospective_records.kind: FORWARD_OBSERVATION_RECORDS: mode OBSERVE, entry authority BLOCKED, reference = decision close, portfolio-selected and counterfactual candidates together; not executable plans

stop_distance: risk / entry price (the same fraction the engine checks)
stop_geometry: risk = max(distance to the prior-24h swing + 0.25 x ATR14, 2 x ATR14, 0.3% of close) on hourly bars
